answer_1.quote: We define the multi-modal response generation and retrieval tasks based on MM-Dialog that are essential for building a more engaging multi-modal dialogue agent.
answer_1.outputs: multi-modal responses consisting of textual utterances or visual images, or both of them

answer_2.quote: In Task-1, we follow  and evaluate the quality of the generated responses by using metrics from both text and visual modalities. For the text modality, we compare the generated text to the ground-truth responses using metrics like BLEU  and ROUGE . For the visual modality, we measure the quality of the generated images using metrics like Inception Score  (IS) and CLIP Score  (CLIP-Sim).

answer_4.quote: Following , we randomly selected 200 contexts from the test set and solicited ratings from three English-speaking volunteers on a 1-5 Likert scale, reflecting their satisfaction with the response (retrieved or generated) to the given context.
answer_4.guideline: reflecting their satisfaction with the response (retrieved or generated) to the given context
